recipe.criteria: Light dumbbell variation of prone L raise. Upper arms lateral at shoulder level, forearms point forward, elbows fixed 90 degrees. Lift arms a small distance while trunk and legs remain stable. 3.5 seconds lift, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds return.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
